title: +*INTRODUCTION TO UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
description: Explore American politics and government. Illustrate how our institutions (Congress, the Presidency, and the courts) work, or at times do not work based on theories of political science. Describe U.S. elections, public opinion, and political behavior. Discuss real-world scenarios and the forces shaping our nation.
